text.guided: You found the right size but the wrong sign. When the matrix turns the plane over, like a page, the shape is mirrored and the determinant is **negative**. Check the L: if it points the wrong way round, put a minus sign.
text.fast: Right magnitude, wrong sign: det < 0 means the orientation is reversed (the shape is mirrored).

scene.caption: Original: the L is the right way round
